title: 第697章 闲谈与修行第696章 酒友
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可正和美一起熔炼各类金属，所有破损的法宝都被回收重炼，大部分材料都能二次利用。
当然这套回收办法并非完美，夹层间一种被艾可称作助熔剂的杂质金属，会腐蚀本体原料，这部分金属只能焚毁舍弃。
但绝大部分材料都能提纯干净，用这些精炼后的材料炼制法器，成功率会大幅提升。
这批回收物资总量可观，足以收纳进大型浮空洲舰中储存。
“说起来，咱们为什么不直接让大家把储物袋都拿出来，用储物法宝转运这些材料？”艾可发现如今几乎没人动用储物类法宝存放物资。
“这片海域有一种奇特力量，若是同一区域内堆放过多储物法器，空间存储的力量会被直接中和失效。”美无奈叹气。倘若能用储物袋，或是借艾可的狐尾来搬运物资，一切都会省事许多，可眼下别无办法。
“你确定要留在这片地方吗？”美不愿把艾可独自丢在这里。
“我还拿不定主意。心底有一股牵引，指向某处，但不靠近目的地，我无法确定那地方究竟在哪。”艾可轻轻摇头。这份感应始终萦绕心头，却并不急迫，不至于让她分心。
她大多时候能将这份悸动抛在脑后，可心底深处，总会莫名向往那个未知之地。
“好吧。”美不愿束缚艾可的选择，却又舍不得与她分开。
“美！”一道怒气冲冲的身影险些直直撞向她。
“怎么了，黛露？”美明明清楚对方发火的缘由，却故作懵懂。
“别跟我装糊涂！你就不能提醒我衣衫都破了吗？！”黛露鼓着腮帮子，满脸委屈。
“谁让你之前没把艾可的提醒放在心上。”美摊摊手，一副无关紧要的模样。
“唉。”黛露一时语塞，找不到话反驳。
“那边的事办妥了？”美抬眼看向她。
“过段时间，他们会派人来取一艘浮空洲舰。那人眼下正闭关修炼。”黛露满心期待对方剑术大成。
她打算等对方修为登顶后，好好把他痛揍一顿，只有这样，才能消掉之前对他的所有芥蒂。
“对了，我还藏了上好的仙酿，等咱们离开此地，正好开坛庆贺一番～”黛露已经迫不及待想要开封那坛云露琼浆。
“哦？”美心生好奇，想知道是什么东西让她这般兴奋，但没有立刻追问，暂且按捺住了好奇。

“总之再过数月他们便会抵达，若是迟迟不来，我便亲自去找他，交易什么时候完成都无妨。”黛露说完便转身准备离开。
“他们那边究竟是什么事耽搁了取舰的行程？”美疑惑追问。
“他快要突破境界了。”黛露轻笑一声，身影转瞬消失。看得出来，如今的她比从前自在洒脱不少。
“这话说了跟没说一样……”美低声轻叹。相比现在这般跳脱的黛露，她反倒更怀念从前沉稳严肃的她。
“我都还没跟她说，艾可或许会留下来不走……”美无奈摇了摇头。
“艾可不跟我们一起走吗？”两道好奇的小脑袋从灌木丛里探了出来。
是暗影峰常年外出执行任务的一对双胞胎狐妖。
“我还没确定。”一切都没有定论，艾可不想提前让她们徒增烦恼。
反正就算要分别，到时候再告知也不迟，她暗自偷偷盘算。
……
艾可穿梭在一艘艘浮空洲舰内部。归属于北方各大宗门的舰船，储物构造最为精巧，可灵石能源的损耗却高得离谱。
以她如今的修为阅历，尚且想不出改良之法。
「更何况空间符文这一块，我完全无从下手……」艾可暗自苦恼，可也无可奈何。等众人安顿下来后，她定要潜心钻研符文，弄明白自身对空间之力感应迟钝的症结所在。
所有浮空洲舰的内部构架高度雷同，仿佛是统一预制打造完成，再由各个宗门自行加装专属的飞行、储物符文阵法。
这件事让她既费解，又心生好奇。
这些舰船虽说能浮于海面航行，可一旦舰体受损，船舱极易进水，完全无法支撑远洋长途航行。
还有一点让她格外在意——舰身上隐匿符文的数量多到反常。
寻常而言，只要位置排布得当，一枚隐匿符文便足以遮蔽整艘舰船，还能和舰体其余阵法串联联动。
可每一段舱体，都密密麻麻刻着数道隐匿符文。
就算说是多重保险，也实在多余得过分，不是吗？

“这片海域会压制天机道韵，倘若不做好完全的隐匿，一旦舰身暴露在海面之上，便是死路一条。”陈石不知何时悄然现身，解答了艾可心中的疑惑。
“这片大海真的这般凶险？”艾可歪头发问。
“海中妖兽何止实力强横，感知更是敏锐到极致。单单遮蔽舰船的形体远远不够，连舰内流转的灵气、众生生灵的生命气息，都必须层层掩盖。”陈石摇头说道。他早年曾因忽视这点，险些葬身沧海。
content_en:
Aike is smelting various metals with Mei. All damaged magic weapons are recycled and resmelted, and most materials can be reused.
Of course, this recycling method is not perfect. There is an impurity metal in the interlayer, which Aike calls a flux, which will corrode the main raw materials. This part of the metal can only be burned and discarded.
But most of the materials can be purified, and using these refined materials to refine magic weapons will greatly increase the success rate.
The total amount of this batch of recovered materials is considerable, enough to be stored in a large floating continental ship.
"Speaking of which, why don't we just ask everyone to take out their storage bags and use storage magic weapons to transport these materials?" Ai Ke found that almost no one uses storage magic weapons to store supplies.
"There is a strange power in this sea area. If too many storage magic weapons are piled up in the same area, the power stored in the space will be directly neutralized and invalidated." Mei sighed helplessly. If you could use a storage bag or borrow Aiko's fox tail to carry supplies, everything would be much easier, but there is no other way at the moment.
"Are you sure you want to stay here?" Mei didn't want to leave Aiko here alone.
"I still can't make up my mind. There is a pull in my heart, pointing somewhere, but it's not close to the destination. I can't be sure where that place is." Ai Ke shook his head slightly. This feeling always lingered in her mind, but it was not urgent or distracting.
Most of the time she could put this throbbing behind her, but deep down in her heart, she would always yearn for that unknown place for no reason.
"Okay." Mei didn't want to limit Aike's choice, but she couldn't bear to be separated from her.
"Beautiful!" An angry figure almost bumped into her.
"What's wrong, Dai Lu?" Mei clearly knew the reason for the other party's anger, but she pretended to be ignorant.
"Don't pretend to be confused with me! Can't you remind me that my clothes are torn?!" Dai Lu puffed out her cheeks, her face full of grievances.
"Who told you that you didn't take Aiko's reminder to heart before?" Mei spread her hands, looking indifferent.
"Oh." Dai Lu was speechless for a moment and couldn't find the words to retort.
"Is the matter over there done?" Mei raised her eyes and looked at her.
"After a while, they will send someone to pick up a floating continent ship. That person is currently practicing in seclusion." Dai Lu fully expected the other party to achieve great swordsmanship.
She planned to give him a good beating after he reached the top of his cultivation level. Only in this way could all the grudges against him be eliminated.
"By the way, I also hid the best fairy wine. When we leave here, we can open the jar to celebrate~" Dai Lu couldn't wait to open the jar of cloud dew and fine wine.
"Oh?" Mei Xin was curious and wanted to know what made her so excited, but she didn't ask immediately and suppressed her curiosity for the time being.
"Anyway, they will arrive in a few months. If they still don't come, I will go find him personally. It doesn't matter when the transaction is completed." After finishing speaking, Delu turned around and prepared to leave.
"What happened on their side that delayed their trip to pick up the ship?" Mei asked in confusion.
"He is about to break through the realm." Dai Lu chuckled and disappeared in an instant. It can be seen that she is much more free and easy now than before.
"It's the same as never saying it..." Mei sighed softly. Compared to Dai Lu, who is so out-of-the-box now, she actually misses the calm and serious person she used to be.
"I haven't even told her yet. Ai Ke might stay here..." Mei shook her head helplessly.
"Ai Ke, won't you come with us?" Two curious little heads poked out of the bushes.
They are a pair of twin fox monsters who go out on missions all year round in Shadow Peak.
"I'm not sure yet." Nothing is final yet, and Ai Ke doesn't want to cause them more trouble in advance.
Anyway, even if they have to break up, it won't be too late to tell them when the time comes, she secretly makes plans.
…
Aike shuttled inside the floating continental ships. The ships belonging to the major sects in the north have the most elaborate storage structures, but the consumption of spiritual stone energy is extremely high.
With her currentWith all my experience in cultivation, I can't think of a way to improve it.
"What's more, I have absolutely no way to start with the space runes..." Ai Ke was secretly distressed, but there was nothing he could do. After everyone settles down, she must concentrate on studying the runes and figure out the crux of her slow response to the power of space.
The internal structures of all the floating continental ships are highly similar, as if they are all prefabricated and then each sect adds its own unique flight and storage rune arrays.
This matter made her both confused and curious.
Although these ships can float on the sea and sail, once the hull is damaged, the cabin is easily flooded, and it is completely unable to support long-distance ocean voyages.
There was another thing that made her particularly concerned - the number of hidden runes on the ship was abnormally high.
Generally speaking, as long as the position is arranged properly, one concealment rune is enough to cover the entire ship, and can also be linked with other formations on the ship.
But every section of the cabin is densely engraved with several hidden runes.
Even if it's multiple insurance, it's really too much, isn't it?
"This sea area will suppress Tianji Daoyun. If you don't hide it completely, once the ship is exposed to the sea, it will be a dead end." Chen Shi quietly appeared at some point and answered Ai Ke's doubts.
"Is this sea really so dangerous?" Aike asked, tilting his head.
"The monsters in the sea are not only powerful in strength, but their perception is extremely sharp. Simply covering the shape of the ship is not enough. Even the spiritual energy flowing inside the ship and the life breath of all living creatures must be covered up layer by layer." Chen Shi shook his head and said. In his early years, he almost died in the sea because of neglecting this point.
